greeting.text: Include the Kobold crew’s labor and risk in a public account. Our capital is Awshowam. Its principal will register this work after the local balance. The outlying witness is at Migshosho (820, 1380).

choices.text: Include the Kobold crew’s labor and risk in a public account.

actions.value: Keep the wisdom obligation; publish revisions honestly.

hint:mission:boarman:wisdom.text: Include the Kobold crew’s labor and risk in a public account. Inspect Migshosho at 820, 1380, listen to the visiting witness, and repair the circuit beside Boarmen Mediator. Inspect the independent reading at Migshosho. Listen to the Kobolds witness. Record a testable commitment with the circuit keeper. Restore the regional circuit.
